Header: Panonychus citri citrus red spider mite, citrus red spider mite, red spider mite, 柑橘红蜘蛛 or 柑橘全爪螨 in Chinese

Prevention: Plant at 3 m row space and 2 m tree space; change to 3 * 4m several years later
Grow cover vegetation like beans inside orchard to enhance natural enemies
Remove residues and litter in the orchard in winter to eliminate overwintering mites
About ½ mm tiny dark-red mites on fruit (Jim
Monitoring: Adult and young mites feed mainly on leaves and sometimes on fruits.
Mites cause tiny grey or silvery spots on leaves and fruits (stippling).
Heavy damage can lead to necrosis of leaves and premature leaf fall
Choose 10 out of 100 trees randomly, and look for small, silvery spots on both leaf sides of new leaves with little up-curling at leaf edge.
Look once to twice a week when branches sprout and during blossoming

At few (1 to 4) mites on average per leaf on less than 10 to 30% of trees, then consider biocontrol, When more than 30% of trees are infected and at more than 5 mites on average per leaf, biocontrol may not be sufficient.
If many ladybeetles, and their larvae are present act later.
Direct Control: Hang 2 to 5 mite - release containers into each tree (each 500 to 600 predatory mites
Amblyseius cucumeris 胡瓜钝绥 螨, such as from
Ltd, or others) or other predatory mites, such as
Euseius into the top of trees at dusk in cloudy days.
No rain within two days is an advantage.
Repeat after a month if red spider mites are still abundant.
Prune branches with many mites or mite eggs in late winter or early spring

But double check product label as each product is different.
Organophosphate group of contact action.
No resistance so far reported, but moderate resistance risk.
WHO toxicity class
II (moderately acute hazardous); pre-harvest interval p.h.i. 20 days; restricted re- entry interval r.e.i. 2 days after spray; Maximum 2 sprays per season in min 14 day interval.
Toxic to fish and bees:
So don’t spray near water or during plant blossoming or near neighboring flowering crops or bee hives
Lambda-cyhalothrin products (such as pyridaben, 哒螨灵，哒螨 净, and others).
Usually 20%WP or 15%EC products at 50-70mg/L or 2300-3000 times dilution in water.
